notes.1: The card, pictogram on a disc, bilingual type and tonal mosaic are right. But beat lock (every cut and key pose on a beat) becomes only 'equal-length cards', row shifts are absent, and 'one family, nothing warm' rules out the chapter-per-hue structure.
notes.2: Close. The small motif cells and the light sweep on the disc are missing, and light mux grain is ruled out.
notes.3: Five tones of one hue, cream for type and depth by value are right, but 'never add a second hue' contradicts the original's set of five hues with one hue per chapter.
notes.4: Title, CJK line, mono HUD and progress ticks match. But subtitles become the CJK title line with 'never a running caption', which contradicts narration captions as a mono line on a chapter-hue band; the second language is hard-wired, not a switch.
notes.5: Mask slide-up type, the figure arriving in parts and fast-out pops are right. But timings are in seconds with no beat grid, 'the mosaic never moves within a card' contradicts the drifting and beat-jumping rows, and there are no grid transitions.
notes.6: Locked frame and the text/stage split match, but 'hard cuts only' and 'the camera never moves' contradict the grid-snapped transitions (sliding rows, dropping columns, iris, tile flip) and the grid-aligned camera moves.
notes.7: Picture-locked cuts and per-element foley fit, but the percussion spine is missing (mallets and pizzicato only), and a voice line per card exceeds 'one line per chapter at most'.
notes.8: Step card, counter and bilingual pair match. Chapter = colour is excluded by §3; the pace ladder and long take are unshown.
notes.9: Consistent. The light-hue contrast and horizontal-pose pitfalls are unshown.
notes.10: Mosaic, figure, card and progress cover the parts, but timing is seconds per card with no beat-based edit list, and the mosaic is fixed per card, with no row shifts or grid transitions.
notes.11: 'One hue only' removes the palette and chapter choices; the structures and endings otherwise fit the style.
